ai.riseBoost.what: Bing priority boost for early-traction (rising) pages

ai.sisterBoost.what: Bing priority boost for sister pages of a hot page

ai.resendDays.what: days before an unchanged page is re-sent to Bing (where the limited quota goes)

ai.exploreShare.what: share of Bing sends spent exploring pages the machine knows least about

ai.qualityWeight.what: how much a page family's landing quality (visitors who really replay) weighs in its Bing value
